maya (sec-eng): FYI DAST found an auth bypass on /oauth/callback in staging. repro shows session creation without upstream SSO assertion.

raj (backend): saw transient 200s around 11:08. we did a temporary keystore RBAC bind for the scan-runner yesterday — could be related.

maya (sec-eng): which binding? can you paste the exact principal?

raj (backend): `serviceAccount:scan-runner@infra` -> `roles/keystore.viewer` granted to project:redwood-staging at 2024-06-02T11:03. intended for a single test run.

li (infra): run this to confirm audit: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.project_id="redwood-staging"' --limit=5`

pager-bot: alert: preview cluster pages suppressed at 11:20 by li.

maya (sec-eng): immediate actions: revoke that binding, rotate the staging KMS test key, and attach the DAST evidence to INC-2024-512.

li (infra): binding revoked at 11:28. kicked off KMS rotation job rot-512.

raj (backend): quick canary done from external IP: curl -> 401 now. looks mitigated after revoke. i'll run full regression.

maya (sec-eng): follow-ups: add RBAC PR checklist item (expiry + justification), update scanner runbook to request ephemeral grants via orchestrator, and persist DAST repro steps in the IR ticket.

pager-bot: ticket INC-2024-512 created with attachments (DAST report, SetIamPolicy audit rows).
